scheme_name: Mother Teresa Asahay Matri Sambal Yojana
other_conditions: Maximum of two children, each not older than 18 years
Children must be studying in a recognized school
Applicant belongs to socially and economically weaker sections of society
Applicant is unable to raise child/children due to financial hardship
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹5,000 per child per year for up to two children, covering education, nutrition, and healthcare.
